title: euodia rotundifolia
intro: Euodia rotundifolia, commonly known as the Fagara or Sichuan pepper plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. The plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Euodia rotundifolia are attributed to its ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, such as cough and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, volatile oils, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
